title: Black Belt · Mockup B — the candidate detail's ⋯ (BB9 · BB6)
subtitle: Drawn on the real preview screens (fake data, Spring 2027, admin). The detail's own ⋯ (bottom left of the detail) keeps only the person and taking-someone-off groups: Edit details · Change plan or Kukkiwon — Withdraw · Delete permanently. Money stays where it is today: on each payment line's ⋯ (Edit payment, Undo payment, refunds, Mark check returned) and on the Print receipt and Record payment buttons. Nothing to decide here unless something looks wrong.

items.caption: PC, Mia Chen (has payments): one Remove candidate opens a box with Withdraw or Delete.
PC: Withdraw (plain, at once, with Undo) · Delete permanently, grayed with "Mia Chen has payment records, so they can't be deleted. Withdraw them instead." (v0.904; or "… has grades …", v0.950).
PC, no payment and no grades: Delete permanently is red and asks first (mockup D).

footer: A withdrawn candidate's detail is unchanged: Edit details — Restore · Delete permanently already follows the order (Restore in Withdraw's place). Unchanged rules: admins only for Withdraw and Delete permanently; staff see Edit details · Change plan or Kukkiwon (grayed once a payment is recorded, "… Ask an admin."); with Hide private details on, Edit details is grayed with "Edit at the desk".
